rubric_hint.rule: 2 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).

Two eligible VU site-bound species were recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m: the lichen Alectoria sarmentosa (nearest 418 m, 2023 and 2025 records, 3 records) and the fungus Phellopilus nigrolimitatus (604 m, 2025). Both list lack of continuity forest among their threats. None within 250 m.

Several site-bound forest NT species were recorded 373-880 m away (Lobaria pulmonaria, Chaenotheca gracillima, Crossocalyx hellerianus, Cystostereum murrayi). None are within 250 m, so the 3-species NT rule is not met. They are supporting context.
Near-site effort is zero records inside the polygon and within 250 m. Effort within 1000 m is below the county median (23 records vs 66, 22nd percentile).

uncertainties: The records within 1000 m come from only 4 observation days, so they may reflect where observers went rather than where species are.
The distance to the polygon edge is 418 m or more for the eligible species, so they may not occur on the site.
12 records were dropped for coordinate uncertainty.
not_established: That the threatened species occur on the felling site.
That the stand has old-forest or continuity-forest features.
That the lack of records within 250 m means anything, since effort there is zero.
next_action: Have a reviewer check the stand for the habitat of the nearby VU lichen and fungus and for old-forest features. A field inventory would help, since the site is poorly surveyed.
